You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From f143647a02825038d8d6251422e1d0ebdcb6d9ea Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Sathya Perla <sathya.perla@broadcom.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Aug 2017 11:45:03 +0530
Subject: [PATCH] bnxt_en: add a dummy definition for bnxt_vf_rep_get_fid()

When bnxt VF-reps are not compiled in (CONFIG_BNXT_SRIOV is off)
bnxt_tc.c needs a dummy definition of the routine bnxt_vf_rep_get_fid().

Reported-by: kbuild test robot <fengguang.wu@intel.com>
Fixes: 2ae7408fedfe ("bnxt_en: bnxt: add TC flower filter offload support")
Signed-off-by: Sathya Perla <sathya.perla@broadcom.com>
Signed-off-by: Michael Chan <michael.chan@broadcom.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>
---
 drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bnxt/bnxt_vfr.h | 5 +++++
 1 file changed, 5 insertions(+)

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bnxt/bnxt_vfr.h b/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bnxt/bnxt_vfr.h
index d8b5f89427fa..7787cd24606a 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bnxt/bnxt_vfr.h
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/broadcom/bnxt/bnxt_vfr.h
@@ -80,5 +80,10 @@ static inline struct net_device *bnxt_get_vf_rep(struct bnxt *bp, u16 cfa_code)
 {
 	return NULL;
 }
+
+static inline u16 bnxt_vf_rep_get_fid(struct net_device *dev)
+{
+	return 0;
+}
 #endif /* CONFIG_BNXT_SRIOV */
 #endif /* BNXT_VFR_H */
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by the absence of a definition for the function `bnxt_vf_rep_get_fid()` when the configuration option `CONFIG_BNXT_SRIOV` was disabled. This led to compilation issues in the `bnxt_tc.c` file, which required this function to be defined even when virtual function representatives (VF-reps) were not compiled in. The patch adds a dummy definition to resolve this issue and ensure that the code compiles successfully regardless of the configuration.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by the absence of a definition for the function `bnxt_vf_rep_get_fid()` when the configuration option `CONFIG_BNXT_SRIOV` was disabled. This led to compilation issues in the `bnxt_tc.c` file, which required this function to be defined even when virtual function representatives (VF-reps) were not compiled in. The patch adds a dummy definition to resolve this issue and ensure that the code compiles successfully regardless of the configuration.
